originalA1ReferenceGate.disposition: Retain and report; the pinned reference framebuffer values came from a different host/backend context and are informational for this Deck OpenGL campaign.

runLevelRequirements.execution: completed, exit 0, no crash or runner termination
runLevelRequirements.state: complete, target stopped, comparison ready, private Mesa driver namespace verified, no issues, cleanup complete
runLevelRequirements.coverage: exact 144 selected and emitted leaves, COMPLETE receipt, 149 unique exact catalog records, all 149 outcome PASS
runLevelRequirements.fixedFieldReference: Pinned reference-results.json except raw timing values and cross-GPU framebuffer values
runLevelRequirements.builtInOracles: For every record whose metadata does not explicitly set oracle_applicable=false, any present oracle_status must be PASS and any present oracle_failure_count must be zero. Records explicitly setting oracle_applicable=false are retained descriptively.
runLevelRequirements.evidence: exact input hashes, plan preparation identity, coverage, receipt, guest results, run state, and cleanup all retained

sameHostDifferential.eligibleFields: framebuffer_fnv1a64 plus metadata work_checksum, result_checksum, KAT/final-state observations
sameHostDifferential.exclusions: Only observations removed by result metadata where oracle_applicable=false or framebuffer_comparison_eligible=false; excluded raw values remain in evidence and the final descriptive report
sameHostDifferential.repeatability: candidate A1 must exactly equal candidate A2, and Complex B1 must exactly equal Complex B2, for every eligible functional observation
sameHostDifferential.firmwareEquality: After repeatability passes, candidate and Complex eligible functional observations must match exactly; any mismatch fails qualification

performance.leafStatistic: arithmetic mean of each run raw_results mean in microseconds
performance.acceptanceOrder: functional same-host differential first; performance comparison second
